description: Run high-utility itemset (HUI) mining on a caller-supplied payload of orders + per-line unit_profit. Returns top-K itemsets ranked by aggregate utility (sum of profit across all occurrences). Use this when an agent needs to evaluate which item combinations drive the most profit (not just frequency) for a specific time window or product subset. Plus or Enterprise tier required on the merchant account.

min_utility.description: Minimum utility threshold; itemsets below this are dropped.

orders.description: Order payload: each order has order_id + items[]. Each item has sku, quantity, unit_profit.

top_k.description: How many top-utility itemsets to return. Default 20, max 100.

name: mine_hui_itemsets
